answer: Every new identity must clear a saffron gate: serially compute a verifiable delay function taking one wall-clock hour, then file the proof in the jade registry before activation. The delay cannot be parallelized, so minting 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 sequential hours, not one hour on 1,000 cores. Each proof is checked on the public beacon log: one key per delay slot, reuse rejected, so the rented-farm ring fails. An honest agent pays the hour once.
